description: Tide times, heights and Peskio coefficient estimates for one place over up to two weeks, with sunrise, sunset, daylight low tides and moon phase. Use for tide times, spring/neap tides, grandes marées, pêche à pied, tidal islands and boat launching. Heights are in metres above the stated datum. Information only: for tidal crossings, tell the user to follow the official crossing schedule. Peskio has no tidal-current or slack-water data: never derive them from these times. Explicitly label coefficients as Peskio estimates in the user language (French: estimation Peskio). Include a clickable link to place.url exactly as returned, query string included.

date.description: Alias of `from` (the name the other Peskio tools use); `from` wins when both are given.

daylightLowOnly.description: Keep only days with a low tide in daylight.

from.description: First local date: YYYY-MM-DD, 'today', 'tomorrow' or an English weekday (the next one, today included); default today at the place.

lang.description: The user's language (ISO 639-1; one of Peskio's 15, otherwise 'en'). Picks the peskio.com page language and local place names; answer in the user's language yourself.

minCoefficient.description: Keep only days whose Peskio coefficient is at least this. Grandes marées: 95. Pêche à pied: 70.

placeId.description: Peskio place id returned by places_search, e.g. "es:es-3108877". Never invent one.

rankBy.description: coefficient = biggest first; low_tide = lowest low first; moon = closest to new/full moon first. Omit for date order.

name: tides_get_table

coefficient.description: The day's coefficient, computed from the day's first high and first low (the site's rule) -- not an average of the per-high coefficients in `extremes`, which can differ from it on the same day.
Peskio estimate for this high tide (paired with the preceding low); null on lows.

weekday.description: English weekday of `date` (e.g. "Sunday"); use it, never compute weekdays yourself.

disclaimer.const: Predicted tides for planning; not for navigation or tidal crossings — follow official schedules

admin1Label.description: The region name in the requested language (admin1 is its English/official form).

today.description: Today's local date and English weekday at the place. Resolve 'today', 'tomorrow', a weekday name or 'this weekend' from it: a weekday that is today means today.

url.description: Canonical peskio.com page for this place. Always give it to the user exactly as returned, query string included.

window.description: The local dates searched. When days is empty, say nothing matched IN THIS WINDOW and search the next one.

title: Tide table
